import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    MOD = 998244353
    n = int(data[0]); k = int(data[1])
    a = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+n]]
    # binomials
    C = [[0]*(k+1) for _ in range(k+1)]
    for i in range(k+1):
        C[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i+1):
            C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % MOD
    coef = [C[k][t] for t in range(k+1)]
    # coefficient for pair: coef[t] * pw[t] * (-1)^(k-t) * R[k-t]
    sgn = [1 if (k - t) % 2 == 0 else MOD - 1 for t in range(k+1)]
    R = [0]*(k+1)
    # add P_0 = 0
    R[0] = 1
    # for s>=1, 0^s = 0, so R[s] stays 0
    P = 0
    ans = 0
    rng = range(k+1)
    for x in a:
        P = (P + x) % MOD
        pw = [1]*(k+1)
        for s in range(1, k+1):
            pw[s] = pw[s-1] * P % MOD
        total = 0
        for t in rng:
            total += coef[t] * pw[t] % MOD * sgn[t] % MOD * R[k-t]
        ans = (ans + total) % MOD
        for s in rng:
            R[s] = (R[s] + pw[s]) % MOD
    print(ans % MOD)

from math import comb

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    MOD = 998244353
    n = int(data[0]); k = int(data[1])
    A = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+n]]
    # prefix sums
    P = [0]*(n+1)
    for i in range(n):
        P[i+1] = (P[i] + A[i]) % MOD
    C = [[comb(k, t) % MOD for t in range(k+1)]]
    coef = [comb(k, t) % MOD for t in range(k+1)]
    # sign factor for each power index m = K - t: (-1)^m
    Q = [0]*(k+1)  # Q[s] = sum_{i<j} P_i^s, s=0..k
    total = 0
    for j in range(1, n+1):
        # add P_{j-1}
        p = P[j-1]
        pw = 1
        for s in range(k+1):
            Q[s] = (Q[s] + pw) % MOD
            pw = pw * p % MOD
        # contribution for P_j
        q = P[j]
        pt = [1]*(k+1)
        for t in range(1, k+1):
            pt[t] = pt[t-1] * q % MOD
        acc = 0
        for t in range(k+1):
            m = k - t
            term = coef[t] * pt[t] % MOD * Q[m] % MOD
            if m & 1:
                acc -= term
            else:
                acc += term
        total = (total + acc) % MOD
    print(total % MOD)
